supportChat.title: Help
supportChat.greeting: Hi! Pick a question below or type your own. I answer from {appName}'s help articles.
supportChat.notice: Never type your recovery phrase or password here. Your question is processed by an AI service to find the right help article.
supportChat.searchingMore: Tip: support will never ask for your recovery phrase or keys.
supportChat.stillWorking: Thanks for waiting, this is taking a little longer than usual.
supportChat.notCovered: Sorry, I couldn't find an answer to that in our help articles.
supportChat.safetyLine: Support will never ask for your recovery phrase or keys, and cannot recover funds.
supportChat.secretBlocked: That looks like a recovery phrase or private key, so it wasn't sent. Never share it with anyone, including support.
supportChat.redacted: Message hidden because it looked like a secret.

errors.invalid: Please shorten or rephrase your question.
errors.rateLimited: Too many questions. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.captcha: We couldn't verify your browser. Please reload the page or try another browser.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Please try again.
errors.busy: Typed questions are busy right now. The suggested questions above still work.
